name: Expo
summary: Platform for building React Native apps.

flows.title: Create an organization
steps: In the dashboard, select the account's username in the navigation menu to open the dropdown menu.
Add a name for the Organization, and edit its slug or invite team members if needed.
Select Create. The new organization's dashboard page opens.

flows.title: Invite a member to an organization
steps: Navigate to Members under Organization settings in the EAS dashboard.
Click Invite. A form to invite a member to the organization opens.
Enter the email of the user to invite and select the role they should have on joining. Only Owners and Admins can invite, and an Admin can give any role up to and including Admin.
